scientific_integrity: All infinite limits are proved analytically using a triangular martingale and common Dirichlet coupling. The finite program checks identities only; no independent audit or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive integer initial counts, fixed k and a,b, balanced symmetric Friedman/Pólya addition, p_N tending to zero, fixed epsilon>0; no quantitative rate or asymmetric/unbalanced extension.
title: Logarithmic-time Dirichlet crossover in vanishing Pólya–Friedman urns
